# Introd

> Verified customer guides for setting up Introd, syncing relationship data, reviewing warm paths, and preparing introduction drafts.

## Start here

- [Documentation home](https://docs.getintrod.ai/): Choose a supported Introd workflow.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.getintrod.ai/getting-started/quickstart): Complete the shortest verified setup path.
- [Product definitions](https://docs.getintrod.ai/getting-started/definitions): Understand the terms used in the product and docs.

## Core workflows

- [Set up your network](https://docs.getintrod.ai/setup-network): Connect supported sources and review their status.
- [Search people](https://docs.getintrod.ai/people/search-people): Find a target and inspect available relationship context.
- [View paths](https://docs.getintrod.ai/people/view-paths): Review connectors, evidence, and uncertainty.
- [Prepare an introduction](https://docs.getintrod.ai/introductions/create-request): Create a draft for human review.
- [Chrome extension](https://docs.getintrod.ai/chrome-extension): Review contextual browsing capture, automatic network-import resume, and the controls for each behavior.

## Trust and help

- [Privacy and security](https://docs.getintrod.ai/privacy-security): Understand integration data, permissions, disconnects, and deletion requests.
- [Support](https://docs.getintrod.ai/support): Contact Introd support, request help from a teammate, and share troubleshooting information safely.

These public docs do not define a supported external API. Do not infer one from browser traffic or internal application routes. Never request or expose passwords, session cookies, OAuth codes, access tokens, private keys, or other secrets.
